The very small heroine who is violent, selfish, possessive about anything she likes and naive. However, she possesses huge amount of potential and power, and is considered the academy's most powerful student, despite being a first-year. She is paired up with Ayumu against her will, but learns to tolerate him.

segments.text: Ability: EDELWIND (allows Erika to interfere with air flow and atmospheric pressure)

One of the world's remaining noble families' daughter, Erika wants to restore her family's reputation by becoming the world's greatest. Erika is like a princess due to the way she was raised up: arrogant but refined. Despite this, she loves traditional foods such as croquettes, and will get mad if she can't eat at least one daily.
Ability: Demon Max Air (allows Mashiro to change the temperature and the humidity of the air, can also create ice)

Mashiro is a taciturn girl who was accepted to the school because of her scholarship. However, she rarely comes to school and just keeps staying in her dormitory room. For some reason, when she's always talking with Ayumu, she starts patting his head in the middle of their conversations.
Ability: Hihiirokane (allows Hikaru to control heavy metal objects with ease)Precise height: 169.1 cm
Hikaru is very old-fashioned, samurai-like girl who wields a sword. She is extremely careful in evertyhing, and plans out pretty much everything she's going to do.

segments.text: Ability: FAUX ECLAIR (allows Tsubomi to release electricity from her body)

A half-Japanese, half-French girl who wears a rabbit hoodie at all times. Tsubomi is a genius at mind, and has a lot of knowledge inside her head, not to mention she loves to create different gadgets. However, her success rate with actually them being succesful is 50-50, and her failed experiments usually explode. Her favorite phrase is "Tsubomi-chan knows everything and anything", which she often repeats.

Ayumu's self-proclaimed childhood friend. However, for some reason, Ayumu can't remember her nor does he remember ever seeing her in the island. Despite this, like a long-time and noisy friend, she calls him "Aa-chan", which tries Ayumu's patience a lot. Ena has some stalker-like qualities as well: despite being in different class than Ayumu and the others, she's always close to them. Ena is also the student council's secretary. She also won't tell Ayumu what kind of gear she possesses, except for the fact that it's not suited for combat.
Ability: Black Buster (allows Ayumu to detonate anything near him by touching it)

The protagonist of the series, he is one of the rare male people on the earth who can use the "engage" ability. He was supposed to move to Tokyo according to his mother's last will, but because of his ability, was thrown into various incidents.
The student council's accountant who is kind to girls and gives rougher treatment to boys.
